# Review: kebra-nagast-ch46-48 (ch. 46-48)

Pass 1 by the adversarial reviewer. No Dillmann and no modern translations were used; lexical calls that could not be settled from the form, the published ch. 45 and the known-forms entries are left hedged (?). `t` was not touched: the 37 `t` values were compared byte for byte with the pre-edit file, and their join (2803 non-space characters) equals the Geʿez of `packet.md`. Units are numbered from 0 (0 is the ch. 46 heading, 36 the last). Only `units.json` was edited (by script); `novel-forms.json` was empty-valued (no gloss.json exists yet) and `known-forms.json` was used as the house-rendering reference.

### Pass 1 — findings refused (and why)

- Unit 3, `i` "'Do so'" for ግበር: kept; "so" is only English completion of the imperative.
- Unit 7, `i` "shown him" for ዘአስተርአዮ: kept; with an agent subject the Ct stem is "revealed/shown", and unit 10 uses the same "shown".
- Unit 1, ጠሊተ "lambs (?)" versus unit 20 አጣሊ "kids": kept; both are hedged and the note on unit 1 says the word covers lamb or kid.
- Unit 6, አምዕዕዎ lemma አምዕዐ (published entry: አምዐ, "uncertain stem"): kept as hedged; the stem is the drafter's guess and no better one can be had without Dillmann.
- Unit 9, ተሀይደት "passed over (?)", unit 8, ይትዔወራ "turn away from (?)": kept; both are flagged as guesses and I cannot improve on them.
- Unit 17, ለዕዘዝከ "dear one (?)": kept hedged; the stem is unknown to me too.
- Unit 19, መሣውዐ መሥዋዕተ as two objects: kept; the drafter's (?) is honest and a construct reading is not forced by the forms.
- Unit 21, መዛርአ "from ዘረወ (?)": kept hedged.
- Unit 33, ይሜግባ "was moving her (?)": kept hedged; I know no better reading.
- Unit 36, ምስዋር "hiding-place (?)" and ወአጸንሕሑ ስኂነ "burned incense (?)": kept hedged; the plan in ch. 45 (burying the Ark) supports the first.
- Units 2, 4, 5, 11: scriptural and personal allusions (Zadok, Numbers 19:2 heifer) checked against ch. 45 and kept.
- Source slips (አባግዐኒወአጣሌ, ወይቤሎግበር, መድኀኒትአበእንተ, the stray አ in the Joash message, ኣስተርእየከ, ዘዘ ዓመት): all kept as printed in `t` and already named in the notes.

## Pass 2

Second adversarial pass, again without Dillmann or any modern translation. `t` untouched: all 37 `t` values are byte-identical to the pre-pass-2 file and their join (2803 non-space characters) equals the packet Geʿez. Every form of the text is in `known-forms.json` or `novel-forms.json`; every novel form has a `gloss.json` entry (no missing, no stray keys). All changes were made by script to `units.json` and `gloss.json`; units are numbered from 0.

### Pass 2 — findings refused (and why)

- አልዋሕ lemma ሊሕ (probably ልውሕ in Dillmann): kept; identical to the published ch. 45 entry (አልዋሐ), and consistency across parts matters more; worth fixing in ch. 45 too if a lexicon is ever consulted.
- ዕዙዝ for ለዕዘዝከ, ጸንሐ / ስኂን, መዛርእ from ዘረወ, ዘይበፅዕ / በጽሐ, በዘያወጽሕ, ውእደ, ይትዔወራ, ተሀይደት, ወአእተውዋ, ወአስተላጸቁ, አርዑት, ሙፃእ, ወ፼ spoken ትእልፍት: all hedged (?) already and I have no better reading without a lexicon.
- እመራዕየ lemma መራዕይ (it may be the plural of መርዔት): kept; not certain enough to change.
- ዘአሠነይከ "caus." and ወይልአኮ "-ሁ" in the note: left; harmless labelling, consistent with the published entries.
- Unit 9 `i` "has passed over" against `l` "went over": left; English sequence, hedged.
- Chapter-heading `i` in units 0, 18, 29 are sentence case where ch. 45 is title case: left; cosmetic.
- Units 1, 2, 4, 6, 10, 11, 13, 14, 15–17, 19, 22–24, 26–30, 32, 34, 35: checked word by word against `t` and the known entries; no further change.
